Bill.BriefDescription: Imposing an additional vehicle fee on certain passenger vehicles.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to an additional fee on passenger vehiclesexceeding six thousand pounds in weight; adding a new section tochapter 46.16 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) An additional fee of one hundred dollars shall be paid andcollected upon car tab renewal on each passenger car that exceeds sixthousand pounds unladen gross vehicle weight if the passenger car isalso subject to the registration fee under RCW 46.16.0621. (2) The department of licensing shall administer and collect thefee at the same time and in the same manner as registration fees underRCW 46.16.0621. (3) Revenue from the fee shall be deposited into the multimodaltransportation account in RCW 47.66.070. (4) The following vehicles are not subject to the fee under thissection: (a) Trucks subject to the gross weight fee under RCW 46.16.070 inlieu of the registration fee under RCW 46.16.0621; and p. 1 SB 5863 (b) Motor homes.
